messages.text: Thanks. I've shut down the miner from the GUI for now. Can I just pull out the power plug from the unit or is there a switch on the board
Searched the web · Nexus L1 scrypt miner BM1491 power switch

Hi, I'm Hal, HeliumDeploy's technical specialist.

Yes, you can just pull the plug. You've already shut it down from the GUI, so it's safe:

1. Switch off the power adapter at the wall socket, or unplug it there.
2. Then pull the power lead out of the miner.

You don't need a switch on the board. I couldn't confirm from the product information whether the L1 has one, but turning it off at the wall works the same way.

Once it's cool, it can go back in its packaging. Your ticket is still with the team, and someone will email you about getting your S1.
